unresolvedConflicts.subject: Manager scope and manifest governance
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The repository snapshot sets canonicalManager to null and knownManager to false for Nuveen Infrastructure, while the supplied manager universe includes Nuveen Infrastructure and official Nuveen materials identify an active infrastructure platform, including the rebranded Glennmont business. Under the governing unknown-manager rule, no vehicles can be included or proposed despite external evidence of a valid platform.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Confirm whether Nuveen Infrastructure should be added as a canonical manager in the FUND_MANIFEST. If validated, rerun the census to enumerate qualifying North American direct-equity infrastructure vehicles.

notes: Scope-limited review stopped at manager identity because knownManager=false enforces OUT_OF_SCOPE_UNKNOWN_MANAGER.
Official Nuveen materials confirm the existence of a current infrastructure platform and the Glennmont rebrand, but repository governance prohibits proposing funds.
No repository fund rows required reconciliation because the snapshot contains zero funds.
